sql_fixes: Normalize and deduplicate mapping variants before aggregation; prevent aggregate aliases from expanding inside HAVING.
Use explicit aliases instead of joined CTE star projections to keep stable wallet and cohort column names.
Sort the outer UNION ALL result for data-quality controls, not the final UNION branch.
calendar: Gregorian only; YYYY-MM and first-of-month YYYY-MM-01
scope: Commercial=ONLINE; InStore=IN_STORE/IN_STORE_QR; Social=SOCIAL. Cohort is first eligible successful order within each sector, not first vertical/payment entry. Cross-sector unique users cannot be summed.
user_type: Voucher on first global SETTLE order across sectors, fixed forever; Unknown is retained.
instructions: Run each full SQL separately on the authorized internal ClickHouse analytical environment. These queries have not been executed on your database.

Set history_start to the first Gregorian training month, data_cutoff_exclusive to the day after the last fully closed month (first of next month). Keep full earlier order history for first-order and PRE_HISTORY identification.
Default cutoff 2026-11-01 is an example, not a claim November is closed. Calendar runs through 2027-12.
Confirm SETTLE semantics, registered_date timezone, deleted-order policy, stable wallet identity, mapping validity and money_divisor=10 (rial to toman once).
Pass uniqueness, missing mapping and invalid amounts checks before exporting. No identifiers, individual orders or user panels may leave the organization.

If small cells are suppressed, do not substitute zero or reconstruct by subtraction. This exact-reconciliation implementation requires an approved coarser aggregate contract before accepting suppressed files.
Complete calendar events and active days only when known at cutoff; blanks are unknown. Calendar metadata is collected; the baseline does not claim calibrated event effects.

Complete available_in_forecast_month with 0/1 where confirmed; blank means unknown, not inactive. Optionally add forecast_month YYYY-MM per payment/sector for month-specific availability. First observation is not launch date.
Sector-specific cohorts mean a person may occur in multiple sectors. Sector totals must not be described as cross-sector unique people.

Only aggregated CSV/JSON is accepted. Upload all 8 files together; publish is atomic and strict reconciliation is required. Legacy four files cannot satisfy fixed cohort size / joint mix requirements.

WITH
params AS
(
    SELECT
        toDate('2022-01-01') AS history_start,
        toDate('2026-11-01') AS data_cutoff_exclusive,
        toDate('2027-12-01') AS forecast_month_start,
        toDate('2028-01-01') AS forecast_month_end_exclusive,
        10.0 AS money_divisor
),
calendar AS
(
    SELECT
        formatDateTime(addMonths(P.history_start, n), '%Y-%m') AS month_id,
        toInt32(toYear(addMonths(P.history_start,n))*12 + toMonth(addMonths(P.history_start,n))-1) AS month_index,
        addMonths(P.history_start,n) AS month_start,
        addMonths(P.history_start,n+1) AS month_end_exclusive
    FROM params AS P
    ARRAY JOIN range(toUInt32(dateDiff('month',P.history_start,P.forecast_month_end_exclusive))) AS n
),
month_lookup AS
(
    SELECT arraySort(x -> x.2, groupArray(tuple(month_id,month_start,month_end_exclusive,month_index))) AS periods
    FROM calendar
),
commercial_map_variants AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        toUInt64(CD.venture_id) AS mapped_venture_id,
        upper(trimBoth(toString(CD.vertical))) AS mapped_vertical,
        toString(CD.category) AS mapped_category
    FROM minio_db.commercial_data AS CD
),
commercial_map AS
(
    SELECT
        mapped_venture_id AS venture_id,
        min(mapped_vertical) AS vertical,
        min(mapped_category) AS category,
        1 AS mapping_found
    FROM commercial_map_variants
    GROUP BY mapped_venture_id
    HAVING count() = 1
),
all_settled AS
(
    SELECT
        O.id AS order_id,
        O.wallet_id AS wallet_id,
        O.registered_at AS order_at,
        toDate(O.registered_date) AS order_date,
        O.venture_id AS venture_id,
        O.merchant_type AS merchant_type,
        O.payment_method_type AS payment_method_raw,
        O.amount AS amount_raw,
        coalesce(O.voucher_discount_amount, 0) AS voucher_discount_raw,
        isNull(O.voucher_discount_amount) AS voucher_is_null
    FROM fms_credit.tbl_order AS O
    CROSS JOIN params AS P
    WHERE O.status = 'SETTLE'
      AND O.registered_date < P.data_cutoff_exclusive
),
commercial_orders AS
(
    SELECT
        S.order_id AS order_id,
        S.wallet_id AS wallet_id,
        S.order_at AS order_at,
        S.order_date AS order_date,
        S.venture_id AS venture_id,
        S.merchant_type AS merchant_type,
        S.payment_method_raw AS payment_method_raw,
        S.amount_raw AS amount_raw,
        S.voucher_discount_raw AS voucher_discount_raw,
        S.voucher_is_null AS voucher_is_null,
        D.vertical AS vertical,
        multiIf(S.merchant_type = 'ONLINE','Commercial',S.merchant_type IN ('IN_STORE','IN_STORE_QR'),'InStore','Social') AS sector,
        multiIf(
            S.payment_method_raw = 'INSTALLMENT', 'Installment',
            S.payment_method_raw = 'POSTPAID', 'Post Paid',
            S.payment_method_raw = 'FINANCING', 'Financial',
            S.payment_method_raw = 'PAY_NOW', 'PayNow',
            S.payment_method_raw = 'WALLET', 'Wallet',
            S.payment_method_raw = 'PAY_PRO', 'Pay Pro',
            'Unknown'
        ) AS payment_method,
        multiIf(
            S.voucher_is_null, 'Unknown',
            S.voucher_discount_raw > 0, 'Voucher',
            S.voucher_discount_raw = 0, 'NoVoucher',
            'Unknown'
        ) AS order_voucher_status
    FROM all_settled AS S
    INNER JOIN commercial_map AS D
        ON toUInt64(S.venture_id) = D.venture_id
    WHERE S.merchant_type IN ('ONLINE','IN_STORE','IN_STORE_QR','SOCIAL')
      AND (S.merchant_type != 'ONLINE' OR (D.vertical != 'SNAPP-VENTURE' AND D.category NOT IN ('in_store','social','ventures')))
),
first_global AS
(
    SELECT
        wallet_id,
        argMin(tuple(voucher_discount_raw, voucher_is_null),
               tuple(order_at, order_id)) AS first_global_voucher
    FROM all_settled
    GROUP BY wallet_id
),
first_commercial AS
(
    SELECT
        wallet_id,
        sector,
        argMin(order_date, tuple(order_at, order_id)) AS first_commercial_date,
        argMin(order_id, tuple(order_at, order_id)) AS first_commercial_order_id,
        argMin(tuple(voucher_discount_raw, voucher_is_null),
               tuple(order_at, order_id)) AS first_commercial_voucher
    FROM commercial_orders
    GROUP BY wallet_id, sector
),
cohort_members_seed AS
(
    SELECT
        F.wallet_id AS wallet_id,
        F.sector AS sector,
        F.first_commercial_date AS first_commercial_date,
        F.first_commercial_order_id AS first_commercial_order_id,
        F.first_commercial_voucher AS first_commercial_voucher,
        multiIf(
            G.first_global_voucher.2 = 1, 'Unknown',
            G.first_global_voucher.1 > 0, 'NonOrganic',
            G.first_global_voucher.1 = 0, 'Organic',
            'Unknown'
        ) AS user_type,
        arrayFirst(x -> F.first_commercial_date >= x.2
                       AND F.first_commercial_date < x.3,
                   L.periods) AS first_period,
        P.history_start AS history_start
    FROM first_commercial AS F
    INNER JOIN first_global AS G ON F.wallet_id = G.wallet_id
    CROSS JOIN month_lookup AS L
    CROSS JOIN params AS P
),
cohort_members AS
(
    SELECT
        wallet_id,
        sector,
        first_commercial_date,
        first_commercial_order_id,
        first_commercial_voucher,
        user_type,
        if(first_commercial_date < history_start,
           'PRE_HISTORY', toString(first_period.1)) AS cohort_month,
        if(first_commercial_date < history_start,
           CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Int32)),
           toInt32(first_period.4)) AS cohort_month_index
    FROM cohort_members_seed
),
commercial_tagged AS
(
    SELECT
        O.order_id AS order_id,
        O.wallet_id AS wallet_id,
        O.order_at AS order_at,
        O.order_date AS order_date,
        O.venture_id AS venture_id,
        O.merchant_type AS merchant_type,
        O.payment_method_raw AS payment_method_raw,
        O.amount_raw AS amount_raw,
        O.voucher_discount_raw AS voucher_discount_raw,
        O.voucher_is_null AS voucher_is_null,
        O.vertical AS vertical,
        O.sector AS sector,
        O.payment_method AS payment_method,
        O.order_voucher_status AS order_voucher_status,
        arrayFirst(x -> O.order_date >= x.2 AND O.order_date < x.3,
                   L.periods) AS activity_period
    FROM commercial_orders AS O
    CROSS JOIN month_lookup AS L
),
activity AS
(
    SELECT
        O.order_id AS order_id,
        O.wallet_id AS wallet_id,
        O.vertical AS vertical,
        O.sector AS sector,
        O.payment_method AS payment_method,
        O.order_voucher_status AS order_voucher_status,
        O.amount_raw AS amount_raw,
        O.voucher_discount_raw AS voucher_discount_raw,
        O.voucher_is_null AS voucher_is_null,
        O.activity_period.1 AS activity_month,
        O.activity_period.4 AS activity_month_index,
        C.cohort_month AS cohort_month,
        C.cohort_month_index AS cohort_month_index,
        C.user_type AS user_type,
        C.first_commercial_order_id AS first_commercial_order_id,
        C.first_commercial_voucher AS first_commercial_voucher,
        if(isNull(C.cohort_month_index),
           CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Int32)),
           toInt32(O.activity_period.4 - C.cohort_month_index)) AS cohort_age
    FROM commercial_tagged AS O
    INNER JOIN cohort_members AS C ON O.wallet_id = C.wallet_id AND O.sector = C.sector
    CROSS JOIN params AS P
    WHERE O.order_date >= P.history_start
      AND O.order_date < P.data_cutoff_exclusive
)
SELECT
    sector,
    cohort_month,
    cohort_month_index,
    user_type,
    count() AS cohort_size,
    countIf(first_commercial_voucher.2 = 0
            AND first_commercial_voucher.1 > 0)
        AS first_commercial_voucher_users
FROM cohort_members
GROUP BY sector, cohort_month, cohort_month_index, user_type
ORDER BY cohort_month, user_type;

SELECT Q.scope AS scope, Q.metric AS metric, Q.value AS value
FROM
(
SELECT 'all_settled' AS scope,
       'duplicate_order_id_excess_rows' AS metric,
       toUInt64(count() - uniqExact(order_id)) AS value
FROM all_settled
UNION ALL
SELECT 'all_settled', 'null_wallet_rows',
       toUInt64(countIf(isNull(wallet_id)))
FROM all_settled
UNION ALL
SELECT 'all_settled', 'null_order_time_rows',
       toUInt64(countIf(isNull(order_at)))
FROM all_settled
UNION ALL
SELECT 'commercial_mapping', 'conflicting_venture_mappings',
       toUInt64(count())
FROM
(
    SELECT toUInt64(venture_id) AS internal_key
    FROM minio_db.commercial_data
    GROUP BY toUInt64(venture_id)
    HAVING uniqExact(tuple(upper(trimBoth(toString(vertical))),
                           toString(category))) > 1
)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'eligible_settled', 'rows_without_unique_mapping',
       toUInt64(countIf(coalesce(D.mapping_found, 0) = 0))
FROM all_settled AS S
LEFT JOIN commercial_map AS D
    ON toUInt64(S.venture_id) = D.venture_id
WHERE S.merchant_type IN ('ONLINE','IN_STORE','IN_STORE_QR','SOCIAL')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'commercial_activity', 'null_or_nonpositive_amount_rows',
       toUInt64(countIf(isNull(amount_raw) OR amount_raw <= 0))
FROM activity
UNION ALL
SELECT 'commercial_activity', 'unknown_voucher_rows',
       toUInt64(countIf(order_voucher_status = 'Unknown'))
FROM activity
UNION ALL
SELECT 'commercial_activity', 'voucher_above_amount_rows',
       toUInt64(countIf(voucher_discount_raw > amount_raw))
FROM activity
UNION ALL
SELECT 'commercial_activity', 'unknown_origin_order_rows',
       toUInt64(countIf(user_type = 'Unknown'))
FROM activity
UNION ALL
SELECT 'commercial_activity', 'orders_outside_four_payment_methods',
       toUInt64(countIf(payment_method NOT IN
           ('Installment','Post Paid','Financial','PayNow')))
FROM activity
UNION ALL
SELECT 'commercial_activity', 'orders_outside_seven_verticals',
       toUInt64(countIf(vertical NOT IN
           ('FMCG','H&B','HOME','GOLD','DIGITAL','FASHION','SERVICES')))
FROM activity
UNION ALL
SELECT 'commercial_activity', 'negative_cohort_age_rows',
       toUInt64(countIf(cohort_age < 0))
FROM activity
UNION ALL
SELECT 'all_settled', 'null_order_id_rows', toUInt64(countIf(isNull(order_id))) FROM all_settled
) AS Q
ORDER BY Q.scope, Q.metric;
